I had a very positive experience at MM Hospital in IC Colony under the care of Dr. Priyesh Sampat. I would also like to appreciate the hospital staff, who were extremely kind, polite, and attentive. During the night when I was in pain, they took great care of me and responded very quickly whenever I needed assistance. Overall, I highly recommend both Dr. Priyesh Sampat and MM Hospital to anyone in need of medical care. Thank you for the excellent treatment and support.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience ever. Lost 15 years of trust in this hospital. Patients are being overcharged unnecessarily in the name of mediclaim. Special mention to Ms. Minakshi Bhat, Ms. Khot, and Dr. Anita Mayeker.

My daughter had a small infected cyst on her leg. Initially, she was able to walk normally, but even after antibiotics, the swelling increased. When the cyst burst and pus came out, we went back for dressing. Instead of simple treatment, we were pressured to admit her immediately for surgery and repeatedly asked about mediclaim.

The hospital quoted around ₹82,000 for treatment of a small cyst. The mediclaim company reportedly asked the hospital 4 times to explain such a high amount, but the hospital failed to provide proper clarification. Later, when the mediclaim company refused approval, the hospital suddenly reduced the amount to ₹71,500 for us to pay directly, again without explaining the charges or why there was a ₹10,500 difference after Mediclaim rejection.

We cancelled the surgery because the charges seemed unreasonable. For less than 24 hours of incomplete treatment, we still had to pay ₹13,000, which Mediclaim later refused to reimburse.

Very disappointing and stressful experience. It felt more focused on money than patient care, I will never ever recommend these doctors or this hospital to anyone.

Overall, I would definitely recommend Dr. Megha and Lotus Hospital for delivery.

featured_reviews.name: Ritesh Poojari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We chose this doctor and hospital based on the positive Google reviews. We visited the hospital with the happiness of a positive pregnancy, but due to an unexpected medical complication, immediate attention and surgery were required. Dr. Megha Anaje quickly identified the issue through prompt tests and treated it as an emergency without any delay. Her timely decision truly made a big difference for us.

She patiently explained the situation and the planned procedure, which gave us clarity and confidence during a very difficult time. The surgery was performed by Dr. Megha Anaje along with Dr. Haresh Vaghasiya. After the procedure, they clearly explained everything and answered all our questions, even showing pictures to help us understand better. Dr. Vaghasiya especially gave us enough time to clarify our doubts and answered all our questions patiently.

I truly appreciated the way the nurses and attendants (maushi) took good care of my wife. They were polite and responsive whenever we called. The other staff members, including receptionists and lab technicians, were also very kind and supportive.

One of the biggest advantages is their in-house diagnostic facility, which made all the required tests quick and hassle-free, especially during an emergency.

We are sincerely grateful to the entire team for their expertise and compassionate care.

featured_reviews.name: Dakshata Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Megha Anaje is an experienced and skilled gynaecologist and obstetrician. She understands whether our problems are something to really worry about or normal. I had searched several hospitals before registering myself into Lotus and  I feel glad that I registered here. I was admitted at 6 pm and delivered a baby in about an hour as normal. She really guided me in the entire labour process and was very kind and gentle throughout my labour. The post delivery was also taken care of very nicely and I had no issues or severe pains later.

The staff:
The staff is exceptionally great and cooperative. The nurses and help staff, actually the entire hospital staff itself is great. No delays observed, concerns very well taken care of, I want to exceptionally thank all the skilled nurses for being so patient and gentle with their patients. I can name a few whose name I remember but that would be unfair for rest of the nurses. Hence, thank you each and every nurse and staff folks who made my experience better at hospital.

All the best to Lotus Hospital, Dr. Megha, and the entire team.

I would definitely recommend this hospital to everyone.

Overall, our experience with Phoenix Super Speciality Heart Care Hospital has been extremely positive. We are sincerely thankful to the entire team for their dedication, warmth, and excellent care.

All’s well that ends well — heartfelt gratitude to everyone involved in my father’s recovery.

Pooja Chodankar

I have been admitted to Bombay Hospital on a few occasions in the past as well — not because I am fond of hospitals, but because my health conditions at times make it necessary.

During my recent admission on the 30th, of April 2026 I was initially admitted to the Critical Care ICCU on the 3rd floor. The ICCU is extremely well maintained, clean, organised, and disciplined. Their leadership reflects positively in the functioning of the entire team. The nursing staff has been warm, attentive, and committed towards patient care, and it is evident that they take pride in their duties.

Like every institution, minor flaws or occasional mistakes may happen, and there is always scope for improvement amongst some of the support staff, ward boys, ward girls, and helping staff. However, it is equally important to acknowledge the larger picture — the effort, compassion, and dedication shown daily by the nursing teams and medical staff under challenging circumstances.

Over the years, I have personally seen many nurses grow from trainees into confident and capable professionals handling immense responsibilities with maturity and experience. That growth deserves appreciation and encouragement.

I sincerely wish the entire team continued success and growth in their careers. May they keep evolving, learning, and rising further in their profession while continuing to provide compassionate care to patients and families who depend on them during difficult times.

I remain grateful and thankful for the care and support extended to me.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst hospital experience and hospitality I have ever seen till now. If you come by bike, there is absolutely no parking facility for you. The hospital only provides parking and valet service for cars, which clearly shows they only care about people who own cars.

That parking was almost 800 meters away from the hospital, and after going there, I found out that even the BMC parking does not allow bikes to be parked there. This practically means that if you come by bike, you are not welcome at this hospital. It feels like this hospital only gives preference to rich people who have cars, while others are ignored. If you don’t own a car, it is honestly better to visit a government hospital instead.

The second bad experience was with the hospital staff. When I asked about the OPD, the staff simply told me it was on the 3rd floor while I was already standing near the lift. After going upstairs, I realized that the OPD was actually located in another building. They should have clearly informed me that I needed to go to the other building instead of giving incomplete information. Because of this, I had to come back down and walk again to another building unnecessarily.

Zero humanity, zero hospitality, poor management, and no proper guidance for patients or visitors. Extremely disappointing experience.
